note: Model catalog in the same shape as the Zed provider settings: name, max_tokens (context window), max_output_tokens (generation cap). The ACTUAL request max_tokens is taken from max_output_tokens, NOT the context window. Editable without rebuild — restart the app to re-read. Current generation per Anthropic docs: claude-fable-5 / claude-opus-5 / claude-sonnet-5 / claude-haiku-4-5. The chat reads the model set in the settings window (config-store.model); this list only pre-fills / validates the datalist.
